description: Generate a screenshot for a given node or the currently selected node in Figma. maxDimension (default 1024) caps the longer edge of the PNG (up to 2x the node size). The response gives a local URL and file path plus width/height and original_width/original_height. Set enableBase64Response to also get the image inline.

contentsOnly.description: Render the node in isolation, without overlapping content.

enableBase64Response.description: Also include the PNG inline as base64.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

maxDimension.description: Longest edge of the PNG in pixels (default 1024).

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: get_screenshot
title: Get Screenshot
